identificationModule.officialTitle: A Study of GC022 CAR-T Cell Immunotherapy for Relapsed or Refractory B- ALL

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Patients with Dose Limiting Toxicity
primaryOutcomes.description: A dose limiting toxicity is defined as any toxicity that is considered to be primarily related to the GC022 cells, which is irreversible, or life threatening or hematologic or non-hematologic Grade 3-5
After GC022 infusion, adverse events will be graded as CTCAE 4.0
After GC022 infusion, GC022 CAR copies in peripheral blood. bone marrow and CSF will be measured by qPCR in 12 weeks

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percents of Patients with best response as complete remission and MRD negative complete remission
secondaryOutcomes.description: Response rates will be estimated as the percents of patients whose best response is complete remission and MRD negative complete remission
